title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Santa Clara University study environments, from computer-ready commons to reservable collaborative rooms.

cards.title: Lower Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons lower level
cards.notes: Set up near the lower-level desktop stations when you need campus software alongside individual study time and a nearby printer.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level computer study area with Windows and iMac stations.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU identifies the Lower Information Commons on the Learning Commons lower level and lists Windows Dell desktops and iMacs for student use there.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons' Computing and Media Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located on the lower level of the Learning Commons; campus computer use is described for students.

cards.title: Upper Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor public computers for a focused work block, especially when you need Windows tools, macOS, or SmartPrint nearby.
cards.short_summary: First-floor desktop stations in the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU states that the Upper Information Commons is on the first floor and has a mix of Windows-based Dell desktops and iMacs available for student use.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons' Computing and Media Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; SCU describes the computers as available for student use.

cards.title: Learning Commons 203
cards.subtitle: Second-floor training and instructional lab
cards.notes: Check whether instruction is scheduled, then use an open workstation for coursework that benefits from installed lab software and campus hardware.
cards.short_summary: A 30-workstation lab that becomes a drop-in lab when unscheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU lists Learning Commons 203 as a 30-workstation training and instructional room that is available as a drop-in lab when not scheduled.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons' Computing and Media Facilities
cards.access_notes: Drop-in use is available only when the room is not scheduled for instruction.

cards.title: Learning Commons 205
cards.subtitle: Second-floor training and instructional lab
cards.notes: Bring a project that needs a full computer lab and use this room during unscheduled periods; ask Technology Training about reservations if needed.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU identifies Learning Commons 205 as a 50-workstation training and instructional room and says unscheduled instructional labs are open for regular computer use.
cards.access_notes: Use for regular computer work when not in instruction; SCU says the labs follow regular building hours.

cards.title: Learning Commons 206
cards.subtitle: Second-floor training and instructional lab
cards.notes: Choose this lab for computer-based coursework when it is not reserved for instruction, and plan around the Learning Commons’ regular building hours.
cards.short_summary: A 20-workstation training lab that can operate as drop-in space.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU lists Learning Commons 206 as a 20-workstation instructional room and says these rooms are available as drop-in labs when not scheduled.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons' Computing and Media Facilities
cards.access_notes: Drop-in availability depends on the instructional schedule.

cards.title: Learning Commons 331
cards.subtitle: Third-floor Multimedia Lab
cards.notes: Use the third-floor multimedia lab when you need an available lab computer; confirm that no instructional session is occupying the room first.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor lab for regular computer use between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU lists Learning Commons 331 among its training and instructional labs and says those labs are open for regular computer use when not in instruction.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor; availability is limited to times the room is not used for instruction and regular building hours.

cards.title: Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable collaborative rooms
cards.notes: Reserve with your SCU ID for a group session, then check in on the door tablet within ten minutes or the reservation can be released.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms with a whiteboard, table, chairs, and display connection.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU says its group study rooms are for the SCU community, reservable with an SCU ID, and equipped with tables, 6–8 chairs, whiteboards, and device-connectable screens.
cards.access_notes: SCU community only; reserve with SCU ID up to seven days ahead for up to four hours daily, or claim an available room in person.

cards.title: Viewing and Production A
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons 129
cards.notes: Reserve this 58-seat media room when a team needs a supported setting for a presentation rehearsal, screening, web conference, or recording.
cards.short_summary: A reservable 58-seat room equipped for media-based project work.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU identifies Viewing and Production A as Learning Commons 129, with 58 seats, and says it supports recordings, screenings, web conferences, and webinars by reservation.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons' Computing and Media Facilities
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; SCU directs users to contact Media Services to reserve the room.

cards.title: Lucas Hall
cards.subtitle: Leavey School of Business shared study spaces
cards.notes: Use the room-reservation system when your group needs a shared study space in Lucas Hall, then plan your meeting around the confirmed booking.
cards.short_summary: A business-school building with study spaces and reservable shared study space.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU states that Lucas Hall houses study spaces, and its student technology guide lists Lucas Hall among locations with shared study spaces reservable through Room Reservation.
cards.access_notes: Shared study spaces are reserved through the Room Reservation service using the MySCU Portal.

cards.entity_name: Howard S. and Alida S. Charney Hall of Law
cards.title: Charney Hall of Law
cards.subtitle: Shared study spaces in Charney Hall
cards.notes: Book a shared study space through MySCU before heading to Charney Hall, especially for a focused meeting that needs a defined academic setting.
cards.short_summary: A law-school building with reservable shared study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: SCU’s student technology guide lists Charney Hall among the locations with shared study spaces that can be reserved through Room Reservation.
cards.access_notes: Shared study spaces are reserved through the Room Reservation service using the MySCU Portal.
